articles.headline: Section 144 imposed in Islamabad; district admin warns citizens against participating in any 'illegal activity'
articles.summary: AI summary: Islamabad's district administration has banned gatherings of five or more people and all rallies across the capital for two months, citing planned PTI and farmer protests, and warned violators could face up to three years in jail as over 22,000 security personnel are deployed.

articles.headline: Govt reduces petrol price by Rs1.93 per litre, HSD by Rs4.21 per litre
articles.summary: AI summary: The government trimmed petrol by Rs1.93 to Rs390.12 per litre and diesel by Rs4.21 to Rs414.75 from Thursday, keeping its Rs114 and Rs100 per litre levies unchanged; prices, now set daily, remain well below their April peak after the US-Iran conflict.

economic.reason: Lower fuel, especially diesel, eases transport and input costs.

political.reason: Routine pricing decision with no governance implications.

social.reason: Slight relief on household fuel spending.

market.reason: Fuel prices feed directly into inflation and business costs.

lean.reason: Factual reporting of an official price notification.

confidence.reason: Official figures reported in full in the article.

articles.summary: AI summary: New Toshakhana rules issued by the Cabinet Division discourage public office holders, except the president and PM, from accepting foreign gifts, require unavoidable ones to be deposited within 30 days, and set up televised auctions whose proceeds go to girls' primary education.

market.reason: Little relevance to markets or business decisions.

lean.reason: Describes the rules factually; no partisan framing, though no outside comment.

articles.summary: AI summary: Ahead of PTI's September 27 march on Islamabad, Punjab's Home Department reportedly asked the Centre to suspend mobile and internet service in parts of Rawalpindi and Attock and deploy Rangers, while Section 144 was imposed province-wide and two highways to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were closed; PTI said the march would go ahead.

political.reason: Escalating standoff between authorities and the opposition march.

articles.headline: Teenage arrested in Bahawalpur over AI-assisted attempt to poison father
articles.summary: AI summary: The NCCIA said it arrested a 17-year-old in Bahawalpur accused of trying to poison his father, allegedly after using an AI tool to research methods and ordering chemicals for a home setup; the agency said the case surfaced through intelligence from abroad.

lean.reason: Straight crime report attributed to the agency.
